lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: So, you missed a full day of class. We don’t exactly hand out scholarships to no-shows.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: Look, if you want to catch up — volunteer, prepare your CV, and at least try to show up. Understood?

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: That’s N late arrival and N absence already. We barely started the week.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: This isn’t optional. Next time you miss class, it will go on your record.
